title.en: Linear trend by the method of least squares

hook.en: Many lines can be drawn through scattered points. Which one is best? The one that makes the squared misses as small as possible.

title.en: State the principle of least squares
Fit a linear trend y = a + bX for odd and even n

say.en: Many lines can be drawn through scattered points. Which one is best? The one that makes the squared misses as small as possible. In this lesson: State the principle of least squares.
Fit a linear trend y equals a plus bX for odd and even n.
Forecast with the fitted trend.

body.en: The principle of least squares chooses the *trend* so that $\sum (y - y_t)^2$ is minimum. For $y = a + bX$ the normal equations are $\sum y = na + b\sum X$ and $\sum Xy = a\sum X + b\sum X^2$. Shifting the origin to the middle year makes $\sum X = 0$, so $a = \frac{\sum y}{n}$ and $b = \frac{\sum Xy}{\sum X^2}$. For even n, take $X = 2(t - \text{mid})$ so X = …, −3, −1, 1, 3, …; then b is the change per half-year.

points.en: Σ(y − yₜ)² is minimum; Σ(y − yₜ) = 0
Origin at the middle year → ΣX = 0

narration.en: Least squares makes the sum of squared deviations from the trend a minimum. With the origin at the middle year, a is the mean of y and b is sigma X y over sigma X squared.
narration.kn: ಕನಿಷ್ಠ ವರ್ಗಗಳ ತತ್ವವು ಪ್ರವೃತ್ತಿಯಿಂದ ವಿಚಲನಗಳ ವರ್ಗಗಳ ಮೊತ್ತವನ್ನು ಕನಿಷ್ಠಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಮಧ್ಯ ವರ್ಷವನ್ನು ಮೂಲವಾಗಿಸಿದರೆ a = y ಯ ಸರಾಸರಿ, b = ΣXy/ΣX².

say.en: Least squares makes the sum of squared deviations from the trend a minimum. With the origin at the middle year, a is the mean of y and b is sigma X y over sigma X squared. Σ(y - y t) squared is minimum; Σ(y - y t) equals 0.
say.kn: ಕನಿಷ್ಠ ವರ್ಗಗಳ ತತ್ವವು ಪ್ರವೃತ್ತಿಯಿಂದ ವಿಚಲನಗಳ ವರ್ಗಗಳ ಮೊತ್ತವನ್ನು ಕನಿಷ್ಠಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಮಧ್ಯ ವರ್ಷವನ್ನು ಮೂಲವಾಗಿಸಿದರೆ a equals y ಯ ಸರಾಸರಿ, b equals ΣXy/ΣX squared.

problem.en: Fit a straight-line trend by least squares to production (thousand tonnes) 50, 55, 57, 60, 63, 67, 68 for 2018–2024. Find the trend values and estimate production for 2026.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Fit a straight-line trend by least squares to production (thousand tonnes) 50, 55, 57, 60, 63, 67, 68 for 2018–2024. Find the trend values and estimate production for 2026.

say.en: Let us work this out together. Fit a straight-line trend by least squares to production thousand tonnes 50, 55, 57, 60, 63, 67, 68 for 2018-2024. Find the trend values and estimate production for 2026.
Origin 2021, unit 1 year: X equals minus 3, minus 2, minus 1, 0, 1, 2, 3.
Σy equals 420, ΣXy equals 84, ΣX squared equals 28.
a equals 420 over 7 equals 60; b equals 84 over 28 equals 3. Trend: y equals 60 plus 3X.
2026: X equals 5, y equals 60 plus 15 equals 75 thousand tonnes.
So the answer is y equals 60 plus 3X; 2026 estimate 75 thousand tonnes.
